end.line: Quillon for Harrow & Vale’s employment team

vo: Harrow and Vale's employment team advises seventy corporate clients. Here is that work in Quillon.
When an HR director emails a policy question, the reply is drafted in Outlook, cited to the policy clause.
In Word, Quillon redlines each settlement agreement to your firm's standard positions, instead of a rewrite from scratch.
Ask one question across a client's whole matter, and Quillon reads every document in it before it answers.
James will walk your team through it on Thursday the twelfth.
